title: Best Vanta Alternatives in 2026: Compliance Automation Software Compared
summary: The best Vanta alternatives in 2026, compared. Transparent pricing, self-serve onboarding, and AI-native compliance, led by Strac Comply.
body_markdown:
Vanta helped create the compliance-automation category, and it is a capable platform. But it is sales-led: you cannot see a price without booking a demo, frameworks are often priced as add-ons, and it was not built for the AI era. If you want **transparent pricing, self-serve onboarding, and AI-native compliance** , there are better options. This guide compares the best **Vanta alternatives** in 2026, led by[Strac Comply](https://comply.strac.io/) .


Strac Comply shows exactly what passes and what to fix across every framework, from one dashboard.

## Why teams look for a Vanta alternative


- **No public pricing.** Every quote starts with a sales call, which slows down a job you could start today.
- **Per-framework add-ons.** Adding ISO 27001 or PCI DSS on top of SOC 2 often means another line item.
- **Not AI-native.** Legacy platforms were designed before AI agents and MCP; they cannot run from your AI tooling.
- **Audit sold separately.** You still have to find, vet, and pay an auditor on your own.

## 2. Vanta


The category pioneer, with broad framework coverage and a large integration catalog. It is a safe, well-known choice for larger teams that are comfortable with a sales-led process and do not need public pricing. The tradeoffs are the ones above: demo-gated pricing, per-framework costs, and a pre-AI design.


## 3. Drata


A strong Vanta competitor with good automation and a polished UX, popular with startups and mid-market. Like Vanta, pricing is quote-only and the audit is a separate relationship. See our full[Vanta vs Drata](https://www.strac.io/blog/vanta-vs-drata) comparison.


## 4. Sprinto


Known for fast SOC 2 timelines and a workflow-driven approach aimed at cloud-native startups. Capable, but again sales-led, with pricing and framework scope handled through their team.


## ✨ The real wedge: transparent pricing


The single biggest difference is simple. With Vanta, Drata, Sprinto, and Secureframe, step one is a sales call. With[Strac Comply](https://comply.strac.io/pricing) , the price is on the page: $4,995/yr for the software, $8,995/yr if you want the audit done for you by a licensed CPA firm on the same invoice. Transparent, all-in pricing is how Strac Comply removes that friction. See[how much SOC 2 costs](https://www.strac.io/blog/how-much-does-soc-2-cost) for the full breakdown.

## 🌶️ Spicy FAQs on Vanta alternatives


### What is the best Vanta alternative?


For teams that want transparent pricing and to start without a sales call, Strac Comply is the strongest Vanta alternative: it publishes its price ($4,995/yr for the platform), runs 100+ automated tests on day one, covers SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA, and NIST CSF 2.0 on every plan, and is AI-native so you can run compliance from your AI agent. Drata, Sprinto, and Secureframe are also capable, but all three are sales-led with pricing on request.


### How much does Vanta cost vs Strac Comply?


Vanta does not publish pricing; you have to book a demo, and reported deals commonly run well into five figures once you add frameworks. Strac Comply is public and self-serve: $4,995/yr for the Platform (bring your own auditor) or $8,995/yr for Certified, which includes the SOC 2 audit by an independent licensed CPA firm. All frameworks are included at one price.


### Is there a Vanta alternative with transparent pricing?


Yes. Strac Comply is the transparent-pricing alternative: the price is on the website, there is a free trial with no credit card, and there are no per-framework fees. Vanta, Drata, Sprinto, and Secureframe all require a sales call to get a quote.


### What makes Strac Comply different from Vanta and Drata?


Three things: transparent self-serve pricing instead of a sales cycle, all frameworks included at one price instead of per-framework add-ons, and an AI-native design that lets you run your compliance program from your AI agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and more) over MCP. Strac Comply is also built on a data-security platform, so your data inventory and evidence build themselves.


### Can I get the SOC 2 audit from Strac Comply too?


Yes. The Certified plan ($8,995/yr) includes the SOC 2 Type I or Type II audit performed by an independent licensed CPA firm, plus a human vCISO, on one invoice. Vanta, Drata, and Sprinto connect you to third-party auditors you pay separately.
